<h3 align=center> Dependencies </h3>

Figura is using an old version of Arch Loom as otherwise, the client or server encounter issues when running. 
Due to Java 8. Therefore some older dependencies are required to run the project.
Some of which are not on MavenCentral, so they are manually included in the folder.

The dependencies are:
- [fabric-permissions-api-v0.2](https://github.com/lucko/fabric-permissions-api/releases/tag/v0.2)
